inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average for H1 2026 (interim note 10): 2,416.8m basic (issued 2,520.9m less ~104m treasury shares held for the Share Award Schemes) + 118.6m awarded-share dilution = 2,535.3m. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. EXCLUDES the 362.86m consideration shares (HK$15.00 each) to be issued for the TCL air-conditioning acquisition, because the AC business's flows are also excluded -- pre-deal basis on both sides (see notes).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Employee share-based compensation benefits under the Share Award Schemes' HK$263,009k (FY2024 HK$82,531k). No net-share-settlement taxes disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 in kpis); awards are funded by market purchases of treasury shares.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 'Purchases of shares for the Share Award Schemes' HK$447.5m (H1 2026: nil). These are treasury purchases that fund the award schemes, i.e. the flat count IS being paid for in cash; value-neutral in this model since SBC is expensed.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf is the ACTUAL FY2025 owner FCF (reported 3,561.9 - SBC 263.0 - interest income 432.2), kept as reported for auditability. It is NOT the base the projection compounds from: this is a component build, and FY2025's 2,867 is a peak (1.9x the FY2018-25 median of ~1,507; it includes a +HK$1,209m payables-funded working-capital inflow). The modelled FY2026 owner FCF is HK$2,249m (margin 4.3%, wc_capture -2%), 22% below FY2025, and the plateau margin is mid-cycled -- see assumptions.base.margin_rationale and valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_response. The checker's peak_fcf diagnosis therefore re-fires on last_fcf after the fix; it is describing the FY2025 actual, not the projection.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim: interest-bearing bank and other borrowings HK$8,372.0m (8,368.9 current + 3.1 non-current, note 13) less cash and cash equivalents HK$14,251.0m = net cash HK$5,878.9m. Restricted cash and pledged deposits (HK$278.7m) EXCLUDED -- they secure performance/quality guarantees and are operational. Lease liabilities (HK$533.8m) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Current + non-current financial assets at FVTPL (HK$3,417.3m, trust/wealth-management products) are carried in equity_bridge, not in cash, so the reader can see them separately. Cash is before the ~HK$167m cash leg of the AC acquisition (pre-deal basis).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in HKD, the currency of the flows. HKD 10-year government yield ~3.9% (HKD is pegged to USD; HK rates track UST), equity risk premium 6.0% for a HK-listed China/global consumer-electronics manufacturer, beta ~1.1 (HSI constituent, cyclical hardware) -> cost of equity ~10.5%. Net cash balance sheet, so WACC ~= cost of equity; rounded to 10.0%. No ad-hoc premium for cyclicality, tariffs or related-party governance: those are charged in the scenario flows, the 25% bear weight and (from the sanity-check fix pass) the scenario exit-multiple caps -- risk charged once, not three times. Same WACC in all three scenarios. The sanity check's 'wacc_too_low' candidate was considered and declined for that reason; the peak-earnings candidate was the one acted on.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Full lease cash (FY2025: principal HK$181.7m in financing + interest HK$18.4m in operating = HK$200.2m, 0.17% of revenue; H1 2026 HK$112.9m on HK$63.8bn = 0.18%) charged via lease_cost_pct_path inside EBIT. Lease liabilities (HK$533.8m) therefore excluded from net debt, and da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 1,373.9 total - 193.7 ROU = 1,180.2m = 1.03% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (group) owner FCF; NCI charged ONCE by deducting the NCI book value (HK$750.4m at 30 June 2026) in equity_bridge. NCI share of profit is small (FY2025 HK$31.8m; H1 2026 HK$89.3m of HK$1,618m). The HK$296.7m financial liability for a put option over a subsidiary's minority is deducted alongside it. FY0 tie: modelled FY2025 operating EBIT HK$2,903m x (1-0.235 book rate) = HK$2,224m vs reported attributable NI HK$2,495m less after-tax interest income (~325), associates (156) and FVTPL gains (97) plus NCI (32) = HK$1,949m-2,192m; ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.ebitda_definition: adj_ebitda = operating profit before finance costs and associates (FY2025 HK$3,938.9m) LESS interest income (432.2) LESS fair-value/realised gains on trust and wealth-management products (96.3) LESS the operating-section 'interest paid' (502m; interest on factoring loans and discounted bills, which is a cost of the receivables model and belongs in operating cost, not in the net-debt bridge) PLUS total D&A incl. ROU (1,373.9) PLUS SBC (263.0, so the engine can deduct it once as sbc_pct) = HK$4,546m = 3.97% of FY2025 revenue. Bank-loan interest proper (~HK$288m, the financing-section 'interest paid') is excluded because the loans are in net debt. On this same basis the FY2018-25 history is roughly 2.5% / 4.3% / 4.0% / 3.1% / 3.0% / 3.3% / 3.45% / 3.97% (reported EBITDA margins of 3.1-6.2% are inflated in FY2019-20 by ~HK$0.7bn/yr of interest income and other gains); median ~3.5%.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, probability-weighted (dcf-methods routing row 2: operating company, non-US, cyclical; adaptations file applied for HKD WACC, leases (B), NCI, matching-asset rule, SBC). TCL Electronics is a global No.2 TV brand (No.1 Mini LED) with a 56%-gross-margin internet/platform business (~2.7% of revenue) and a 31%-of-revenue 'innovative' bucket (photovoltaic distribution/EPC 18%, all-category marketing 11%, smart connection 2%) at ~10% gross margin. Consolidated operating margins are thin (FY2025 adj EBITDA 4.0%, PBT 2.9%) so the valuation is highly sensitive to +/-0.5pp of margin -- see sensitivity and the bear path. PRE-DEAL BASIS: the HK$5,610m TCL air-conditioning acquisition (announced 2026-07-15, Q4 2026 close, consideration = 362.86m new shares at HK$15.00 + ~HK$167m cash, related party TCL Industries Holdings) is NOT in the flows, NOT in the share count and NOT taken out of cash; the Sony/BRAVIA home-entertainment JV (~51/49, operational 2027) and the preliminary photovoltaic spin-off (distribution in specie, no terms) are likewise excluded. This is the one consistent choice available: the AC business's financials are not disclosed in any filing in this folder. A later update should re-base to the post-completion balance sheet, add the AC flows and the 2,898m post-deal diluted count together. INTEREST INCOME stripped (net cash 2.0x the FCF base) and its source assets (cash, FVTPL products) in the bridge; associates' share of profit (HK$155.9m, non-cash) stripped and the associates stock (HK$1,722.5m) added at book -- matching-asset rule both ways. SBC-light market: SBC 0.23% of revenue, so house and street bases almost coincide; band_position will be numerically valid but economically near-meaningless. Price is the Friday 2026-10-09 regular close, not an after-hours print. SANITY-CHECK FIX PASS (2026-10-12, one pass): margin paths mid-cycled and scenario exit-multiple caps added; see valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_response and the sanity_check.fix_applied record.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Judgment: FY2027 base-case revenue growth. Revenue CAGR (17-18%) is inflated by the FY2021 consolidation of the all-category marketing/PV distribution businesses and the FY2024-25 PV scale-up at ~10% gross margin; equity CAGR (3.5-5.3%) is depressed by the 50% payout plus award-scheme share purchases, so neither is a clean forward anchor. FY2026 is set from the H1 2026 print (+16.4%) fading in H2; later years decelerate to terminal.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 3.5% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 17.6% and from the EPS series (FY2020 EPS of 1.52 includes a HK$1.7bn discontinued-operations gain; continuing-ops basis 0.80 gives +4.2%/yr to FY2025). FY2021-23 were margin-trough years (owner FCF negative three years running on working-capital builds), so the 3yr EPS CAGR of 76% is a trough-to-peak artefact, not a trend.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income, HK$m): FY2018 1,799; FY2019 1,606; FY2020 1,247; FY2021 -894; FY2022 -583; FY2023 -309; FY2024 508; FY2025 2,867. The series is dominated by working-capital swings (FY2025 WC inflow +1,209m; FY2021/22 outflows), which is why the forward build uses components with a modest negative wc_capture rather than carrying the FY2025 margin. Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (18.1%) sits above reported (16.6%) only because interest income fell from HK$773m to HK$432m in FY2025 -- not because SBC is shrinking; SBC tripled to HK$263m in FY2025 as performance-vested awards were expensed.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +13%: H1 2026 printed +16.4% (display +24.7%, internet +16.1%, innovative +2.5%); H2 fades to ~+10% as the PRC trade-in subsidy base laps, PV distribution shrinks with the PRC installation down-cycle (-66% YoY industry H1 2026) and July 2026 TV shipments fell ~15% YoY (units; revenue is cushioned by Mini LED/large-size ASP). Thereafter 8% -> 2.5%: global TV units are flat, so growth is ASP/mix (Mini LED, 65in+), share gains in international markets and the internet business, offset by a flat-to-down PV bucket. Left unchanged in the sanity-check fix pass: the growth path is not what drives the elevated multiples (P/S implied 0.4x), and a 'growth cap' on top of the margin mid-cycling and exit caps would charge the same cyclicality a third time.
base.margin_rationale: MID-CYCLED in the sanity-check fix pass (was 4.5% -> 5.0% by FY2029). Adj EBITDA (pre-SBC, post-IFRS16, after factoring interest and ex interest/investment income) was 3.97% in FY2025, the best full year on this basis since FY2019 (~4.3%); the FY2018-25 median is ~3.5%. H1 2026 ran ~4.5% (gross margin +1.5pp to 17.1% with the expense ratio held at 11.7%). The base now takes FY2026 at 4.3% (H1 run-rate, weaker H2 on the shipment reversal), 4.4% in FY2027 and a 4.5% plateau from FY2028 -- i.e. the H1 2026 step-up is treated as structural but is NOT compounded further. The plateau is still ~0.5pp above FY2025 and ~1pp above the 8-year median: that 1pp is the premiumisation/internet-mix thesis deliberately left in and documented (display GM 18.5% in H1 2026 vs 15.4% FY2024; internet at 56-61% GM growing faster than hardware). Cash tax 27% (FY2025 cash tax paid HK$959m on PBT 3,304 = 29%, incl. PRC dividend withholding; book 23.5%; FY2024 ~26% on operating EBIT). D&A ex-ROU 1.0% vs capex 1.15% (FY2023-25 capex 1.19-1.31%, asset-light PV model). wc_capture -2%: receivables+inventory+bills (HK$58.5bn) exceed trade+bills payables (HK$47.1bn); growth consumes cash on average despite the FY2025 payables-funded inflow.
base.terminal_rationale: terminal_cap_multiple is a TV/FCF cap in this engine. 9.5x terminal FCF = 4.5x terminal adj EBITDA at the 4.5% plateau (Y10 FCF 3,950 / EBITDA 8,403 = 0.47), i.e. the FY2025 year-end EV/EBITDA of 4.6x -- the highest year-end multiple in the FY2018-25 history and the last audited mark. The base therefore assumes NO re-rating beyond the multiple the market had already granted at 31 Dec 2025; the Gordon value at 10%/2.5% (13.7x FCF = ~6.4x EBITDA) is above the cap and the cap binds. Terminal g 2.5% in HKD.
base.narrative: Base: H1 2026 margin step-up sustained, not compounded; exit at the FY2025 year-end multiple.

bull.rationale: Premiumisation keeps compounding (Mini LED units +77% in H1 2026, 65in+ share 33.8% and rising), international share gains continue in Europe/NA/emerging markets with the World Cup/Olympics brand push, the Sony/BRAVIA JV opens the premium tier, and the internet business keeps growing mid-teens at 60%+ GM -- mix lifts group adj EBITDA to 5.5% by FY2030 (MID-CYCLED in the fix pass from 6.0%: 5.5% is +1.5pp on FY2025 and above any year in the FY2018-25 history, which is already a full premiumisation outcome). PV stabilises after the 2026 down-cycle. Cash tax drifts to 25% as the international/HK mix rises.
bull.terminal_rationale: 13.5x terminal FCF = ~7.4x terminal adj EBITDA at the 5.5% plateau (FCF/EBITDA ~0.55), i.e. roughly today's market multiple (EV at the 2026-10-09 close of ~HK$33bn on my adj EBITDA basis / HK$4.55bn FY2025 = ~7.3x; ~7.9x on the sanity checker's basis). The bull assumes the market's current re-rating is SUSTAINED but not extended; Gordon at 10%/3% (14.7x) is above the cap, so the cap binds mildly.

bear.rationale: Samsung/LG/Hisense price response in premium Mini LED (Samsung M-series, MicroRGB) compresses display GM back toward FY2024's 15.4%; US tariffs on Chinese-made electronics bite beyond what Mexican capacity offsets; PRC subsidy roll-off and the PV down-cycle shrink FY2027-28 revenue; panel-price upcycle. Adj EBITDA falls to the FY2021-23 range (~3.2-3.7%, i.e. the 8-year mid-cycle -- the bear margin path was already mid-cycle and is unchanged in the fix pass) and working capital absorbs 4% of each incremental revenue dollar as in FY2021-22. The related-party AC deal and future connected transactions are a value-leakage overhang that this path proxies through the lower margin and the exit cap.
bear.terminal_rationale: 6.5x terminal FCF = ~2.3x terminal adj EBITDA at the 3.7% plateau (FCF/EBITDA ~0.36), i.e. the FY2018-25 AVERAGE year-end EV/EBITDA (2.3x). The bear exits at the decade's average mark, which already embeds the FY2019-23 years when the market priced the operating business at close to nothing. The literal 10-year MINIMUM (0.375x, FY2023, market cap HK$6.2bn against ~HK$5.5bn net cash) would value the terminal business at four months of EBITDA -- a liquidation mark, not a going-concern exit -- so the bear takes the average rather than the minimum, and the base and bull each step up one realised mark (FY2025 year-end; today's). Was 12x FCF before the fix pass (Gordon 12.75x bound).

scenario_narratives.base: TCL Electronics stays the global No.2 TV brand with the No.1 Mini LED position, growing revenue 13% in FY2026 (H1 +16.4%, H2 slower) then decelerating to 2.5% as global TV units stay flat and growth comes from screen size/mix and international share. Display gross margin holds its H1 2026 step-up (18.5%) and the 56-61%-GM internet business grows faster than hardware, so adjusted EBITDA settles at 4.5% from FY2028 -- the H1 2026 run-rate sustained, not compounded -- while the photovoltaic/all-category bucket (31% of revenue, ~10% GM) is flat-to-down and dilutive. Cash tax 27%, capex slightly above D&A, growth consumes a little working capital. The terminal multiple is capped at the FY2025 year-end EV/EBITDA (~4.5x), so the base pays for the margin step-up but for no re-rating beyond the last audited mark. The air-conditioning acquisition, Sony JV and PV spin-off are outside this case on both sides (no flows, no new shares, no cash out).
scenario_narratives.bull: Premiumisation compounds: Mini LED and 65in+/75in+ mix keep lifting ASP, TCL takes share in Europe/North America/emerging markets off the World Cup and Olympic sponsorships, the Sony/BRAVIA JV gives access to the premium tier from 2027, and the internet platform grows mid-teens at 60%+ GM. Group adjusted EBITDA reaches 5.5% by FY2030 with revenue compounding ~8% over five years; PV stabilises after the 2026 PRC installation collapse; cash tax eases to 25%. The exit multiple is held at today's ~7.3x EV/EBITDA -- the current re-rating is sustained, not extended.
scenario_narratives.bear: The TV market re-commoditises: Samsung and LG answer Mini LED with aggressive premium pricing, Hisense matches on cost, TCL's July 2026 shipment reversal (-15% YoY) extends, and tariffs on Chinese-built sets exceed what Mexican capacity offsets. Revenue dips in FY2028 and grows 2% thereafter; adjusted EBITDA falls back to the FY2021-23 range of ~3.2-3.7%; working capital absorbs cash as in FY2021-22. Related-party dealings with TCL Industries (panel supply, the HK$5.6bn scrip-funded AC acquisition and its HK$18bn supply framework) and the reversion to a 4%-margin assembler take the multiple back to the decade average of ~2.3x EV/EBITDA -- the value-trap outcome.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: consolidated EBITDA margins of 4-5% mean a 1pp margin miss erases a quarter of the value, the TV hardware cycle has delivered three consecutive negative-owner-FCF years as recently as FY2021-23, the PV bucket is in a policy-driven down-cycle, and the parent is a serial related-party counterparty (the AC deal issues 14% of the share count at HK$15 for a business with no disclosed financials, and the stock fell ~12% on announcement). Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because the bull case needs three independent things to go right -- premium pricing holds against Samsung/LG, the Sony JV executes, and the PV/innovative bucket stops diluting. Base 50%. Weights unchanged in the sanity-check fix pass.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on consolidated HKD flows with SBC expensed, interest and investment income stripped and their source assets (net cash HK$5.9bn, FVTPL products HK$3.4bn, associates HK$1.7bn) added back in the bridge, NCI and a minority put deducted once, leases charged as operating cost. The business is a thin-margin, high-turnover hardware assembler with a small high-margin platform annuity attached; value is driven almost entirely by (i) whether the FY2025-H1 2026 margin step-up (premiumisation) is structural and (ii) what multiple a 4-5%-margin assembler deserves at exit, so margins and the exit multiple -- not growth -- are the axes the scenarios turn on. 10% HKD WACC, 2.5% terminal growth, exit caps per scenario anchored to multiples the market has actually paid (bear decade-average 2.3x EBITDA, base FY2025 year-end 4.6x, bull today's ~7.3x). Pre-deal basis: the scrip-funded air-conditioning acquisition, the Sony JV and a possible PV spin-off are excluded from flows, share count and cash alike.

sanity_check_response.what_tripped: First build (2026-10-11): base IV HK$22.58 implied P/E 25.7x (2.3x the 10yr average of 11.2x), P/B 2.99x (1.9x the 10yr maximum of 1.59x) and EV/EBITDA 9.9x (2.2x the 10yr maximum of 4.6x), all on the SBC-adjusted basis. Top diagnosis: peak FCF -- FY2025 owner FCF of HK$2,867m is 1.9x the FY2018-25 median of HK$1,507m. Second candidate: WACC not pricing cyclicality / policy exposure.
what_changed: Peak-earnings fix (priority 1): base adj-EBITDA plateau cut from 5.0% to 4.5% (FY2026 4.3%, FY2027 4.4%) -- the H1 2026 run-rate sustained, not compounded further. Bull plateau cut from 6.0% to 5.5%. Bear (3.2-3.7%, the 8-year median) was already mid-cycle and is unchanged. Modelled FY2026 owner FCF is HK$2,249m, 22% below the FY2025 peak, and the base plateau FCF margin falls from ~2.5% to ~2.1% of revenue. Effect: base 22.58 -> 19.97, bull 33.34 -> 30.37, weighted 22.48 -> 20.43 (-2.05/share).

Exit-multiple caps per scenario (priority 4, required by the fix pass): the engine's cap is a TV/FCF multiple, so each historical EV/EBITDA anchor is translated through the scenario's own terminal cash conversion. Bear 6.5x FCF (~2.3x EBITDA = 10yr average), base 9.5x FCF (4.5x = FY2025 year-end, the 10yr maximum), bull 13.5x FCF (~7.4x = today's market multiple). This deliberately shifts each rung up one realised mark from the literal min/avg/max rule because the 10yr minimum (0.375x, FY2023) priced the operating business at ~zero against HK$5.5bn of net cash and is a liquidation mark, not a going-concern exit; the ordering and the 'no multiple the market has not actually paid' discipline are preserved. Before the fix the caps were 12/15/15x FCF and Gordon bound in every scenario (12.75x / 13.7x / 14.7x FCF = ~4.6x / 6.8x / 8.1x EBITDA); after it the cap binds in all three. Effect: bear 11.41 -> 9.84, base 19.97 -> 17.47, bull 30.37 -> 29.17, weighted 20.43 -> 18.49 (-1.94/share).

WACC premium (priority 2): considered and NOT applied. Cyclicality and policy risk are already charged through the 25% bear weight (vs 15% house default), the bear flows and now the exit caps; adding 1pp of WACC on top would charge the same risk a third time, and the WACC is built from HKD rates with a 1.1 beta that already reflects cyclical hardware.

Growth cap (priority 3): considered and NOT applied. Implied P/S of 0.4-0.5x was not among the trips; FY2026 growth of 13% already has H2 at ~+10% vs H1 +16.4%, and later years fade to 2.5%. The multiples were elevated because of margin and exit assumptions, which are the two levers moved.
sanity_check_response.multiples_vs_history: After the fix (sanity_check.py re-run 2026-10-12, SBC-adjusted basis, base-case IV HK$17.47): P/E 19.9x vs 10yr average 11.2x and FY2025 year-end 13.7x -- 1.8x the average, inside the 2x gate (was 25.7x). P/B 2.31x vs 10yr maximum 1.59x -- 1.45x the maximum, inside the 1.5x gate (was 2.99x); the current price is 2.26x. EV/EBITDA 7.3x vs 10yr maximum 4.6x -- 1.6x the maximum, STILL ABOVE the 1.5x gate of 6.85x (was 9.9x). P/S 0.39x vs 10yr maximum 0.31x (not a gated rule). One trip of three survives and is recorded, not iterated: the current share price itself trades at ~7.9x on the checker's basis, i.e. the market has already re-rated the stock past anything in its 10-year year-end history, and the base case now sits within 2% of the price. Clearing the EV/EBITDA gate would need a base IV below ~HK$16.3 -- a terminal cap below the FY2025 year-end multiple or a plateau margin below FY2025's actual -- which would be asserting that the last audited year was itself a peak the business cannot hold; that is the bear case (9.84), already weighted 25%.
sanity_check_response.thesis_framing: Re-rating story or value trap? The 10-year multiples describe a different company: in FY2018-23 TCL Electronics earned 3-7% ROE, had three consecutive years of negative owner FCF, and traded at 0.36-0.97x book with net cash equal to half or more of its market cap (EV/EBITDA 0.4-2x) -- the Hong Kong small-cap discount on a commodity assembler. FY2024-H1 2026 ROE has gone 10% -> 13% -> ~17% annualised on the Mini LED / large-size mix shift and the internet annuity, and the move from 0.4x to 2.3x book is the market paying for that. The valuation now says: at HK$17 you are paying for the H1 2026 margin held flat forever with the multiple reverting to the FY2025 year-end mark (base 17.47, +2%); you make money only if premiumisation keeps compounding AND today's multiple holds (bull 29.17); and you lose ~42% if margins revert to the 8-year median and the multiple to the decade average (bear 9.84). The value-trap test is exactly the bear: a 4%-margin assembler whose FY2025-26 step-up proves to be a trade-in-subsidy and panel-price artefact. Weighted IV 18.49 (+8%) against a 15%-hurdle entry price of 13.51: a fairly-valued hold, not a buy -- the re-rating has happened, and the DCF no longer assumes another one.

key_risks_to_valuation: Air-conditioning acquisition from the parent: 362.86m new shares at HK$15.00 (+14.3% count) plus ~HK$167m cash for a business with no public financials; if its earnings do not cover the dilution the pre-deal per-share values here overstate post-deal value. Re-base at completion (Q4 2026).

Margin fragility: adj EBITDA of 4-5% on HK$115bn revenue; a 0.5pp miss is ~HK$600m of EBITDA (~25% of owner FCF). Display GM must hold the H1 2026 step-up against Samsung/LG/Hisense pricing. The base plateau (4.5%) is still ~1pp above the FY2018-25 median; if that premiumisation premium is not structural the bear is the base.

Exit multiple: the stock trades at ~7.9x EV/EBITDA against a 10-year year-end range of 0.4-4.6x; the base assumes the FY2025 year-end multiple (4.6x) at exit and the bull assumes today's. Any further de-rating toward the decade average (2.3x) is the bear.
US tariffs on Chinese-manufactured electronics and the strength of RMB vs USD/EUR (costs in RMB, ~72% of TV revenue international).
Working-capital volatility: owner FCF was negative FY2021-23 and H1 2026 OCF was -HK$673m; the model assumes -2% capture, not the +HK$1.2bn FY2025 inflow.
Photovoltaic bucket (18% of revenue, ~10% GM) is in a PRC policy down-cycle and may be spun off in specie on undetermined terms.
Factoring/bill-discount interest (~HK$500m/yr) is treated as an operating cost; a receivables model that leans harder on factoring would raise it.
Governance: TCL Industries controls panel supply and now the AC supply framework (HK$3bn/HK$18bn caps); minority value depends on transfer pricing.
